'''Chen-Yu Liu''' (born 13 June 1975) is a Taiwanese [[nuclear physicist]]. She is a professor at the [[University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign]]. 

== Education and career ==
Chen graduated from [[National Taiwan University]] with a [[B.S.]] in physics in 1997, then earned her [[Ph.D.]] from [[Princeton University]] in 2002.<ref name="casiub">{{cite news |title=Chen-Yu Liu |url=https://physics.indiana.edu/directory/all-faculty-scientists/faculty/liu-chen-yu.html |access-date=21 October 2021 |publisher=The College of Arts and Sciences, Indiana University Bloomington}}</ref> Her doctoral dissertation, completed under physicist Albert Young, was titled, "A superthermal ultra-cold neutron source".<ref>{{cite thesis |last=Liu |first=Chen-Yu |title=A superthermal ultra-cold neutron source |date=June 2002 |type=PhD Thesis |publisher=[[Princeton University]] ([[Proquest]]) |url=https://www.proquest.com/openview/ad52b9f80157072168ca1ab427a75d90/1?pq-origsite=gscholar&cbl=18750&diss=y}}</ref>

After receiving her doctorate, Chen completed a three-year postdoctoral research fellowship at [[Los Alamos National Laboratory]].<ref name="casiub" /> She began teaching at [[Indiana University Bloomington]] in 2005, and was appointed the James H. Rudy Professor of Physics there.<ref name="iubnamedprof">{{cite news |title=Chen-Yu Liu |url=https://alliance.iu.edu/members/member/10408.html |access-date=21 October 2021 |publisher=IU Alliance of Distinguished and Titled Professors}}</ref> She received a [[Sloan Research Fellowship]] in 2007,<ref name="iubnamedprof" /> and was elected a fellow of the [[American Physical Society]] in 2018, for her research into experimental nuclear physics.<ref name="iubphysics">{{cite news |title=Chen-Yu Liu |url=https://physics.indiana.edu/about/directory/all-faculty-scientists/liu-chen-yu.html |access-date=21 October 2021 |publisher=Indiana University Bloomington Department of Physics}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=APS Fellow Archive |url=https://www.aps.org/programs/honors/fellowships/archive-all.cfm?initial=L&year=&unit_id=&institution= |access-date=21 October 2021 |publisher=American Physical Society}}</ref> In 2022, she became a professor of physics at the [[University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign]].<ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |title=Chen-Yu Liu |url=https://physics.illinois.edu/people/directory/profile/chenyliu |access-date=2024-04-12 |website=University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign Department of Physics |language=en}}</ref>
